description: Consent to display a free-standing single sided internally illuminated static advertisement to replace the existing advert.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The advertisement display shall be statically illuminated and the level of luminance shall not exceed 600cd/m2 at any time, or exceed the levels set out in the Institution of Lighting Professionals report PLG05 THE BRIGHTNESS OF ILLUMINATED ADVERTISEMENTS (2015).
Condition : 8 - The proposed signage must not display any intermittent light source, animation, flashing or moving (or apparently moving) feature or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 9 - The levels of luminance on the digital sign should be controlled by a light sensor to measure the ambient brightness and dimmers to control the lighting output to within agreed limits.

Condition : 10 - The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 10 seconds and the interval between advertisements shall take place over a period no greater than one second; the complete screen shall change with no visual effects (including fading, swiping or other animated transition methods) between displays and the display will include a mechanism to freeze the image in the event of a malfunction
Condition : 11 - No advertisement displayed shall resemble traffic signs, as defined in section 64 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984.

Condition : 12 - The footway and carriageway on Chiswick High Road must not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the proposal. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian, or obstruct the flow of traffic.
